💡 CTF-Bpy is the first photochargeable covalent organic framework storing electrons reducing enough to drive dark H2 evolution. This establishes fully organic frameworks for dark photocatalysis and guides rational optoionic material design.

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Atomically dispersed Ce regulates the interfacial water/proton environment around Fe2 atomic pairs, suppressing the competing 2e– peroxide pathway and enabling the 4e– route. This decouples the activity–stability trade-off, yielding 0.92 V half-wave potential, 1.6% peroxide, 96% current retention over 50,000 s, and 1100 h Zn–air cycling—establishing interfacial pathway regulation as a design strategy for alkaline ORR catalysis.

Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Nanorod high-nickel cathodes (including LiNiO₂) achieve stable cycling up to 4.95 V, unlike microcrystal counterparts. The novelty is that bulk structural reversibility, enabled by the nanorod morphology tolerating H2–H3 interphase lattice mismatch, allows full H3-to-H2 recovery on discharge. This enables high-voltage operation without sacrificing energy density, offering a design principle for durable high-energy lithium-ion batteries.

Angewandte Chemie International Edition | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Fluorine-doped graphene with tailored sp²-C─F bonding enables reversible O₂–H₂O₂ interconversion by tuning OOH* binding. This replaces sluggish 4e⁻ zinc-air chemistry with faster 2e⁻ pathways, yielding durable, high-power batteries. The work establishes a structure-property principle linking fluorine-induced polarization to oxygen-peroxide kinetics, advancing fluorinated carbons for reversible energy storage.

item.title: Phosphoric Acid Cross-linking Regulates Closed Pores for Scalable Hard Carbon Anodes
item.description:
استراتژی اتصال عرضی با اسید فسفریک، حفرات بسته کربن سخت مشتق از نشاسته را تنظیم کرده و ظرفیت ۳۹۵.۸ mAh g−1 در آند باتری سدیم-یون ایجاد می‌کند.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces phosphoric acid-induced cross-linking as a novel strategy to precisely regulate closed pores in starch-derived hard carbon. It boosts carbon yield from 14.0% to 31.7% and delivers 395.8 mAh g⁻¹ with 89.4% initial Coulombic efficiency. The 3.5 Ah cylindrical cell retains 96.5% capacity after 500 cycles, offering a scalable, cost-effective route for practical Na-ion battery anodes.
🏷 hard carbon anode · sodium-ion battery · closed pores · phosphoric acid · cross-linking

item.title: Rewriting Precursor Information into Working Structures and Interfaces: MOF‐Derived Electrodes for Rechargeable Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This Review reframes MOF-derived battery electrodes around how conversion rewrites precursor information into working structures and interfaces, distinguishing retention, reconstruction, erasure, and emergence. Its novelty lies in this material-centered, function-oriented framework linking precursor chemistry to interfacial continuity and reversible reaction, rather than cataloguing products. It matters because it guides predictive design, operando characterization, and practical deployment balancing performance against inactive mass, complexity, and cost.
